title: Senior Application Security Engineer – Cryptography
description:
**Company Description** 
 Ahy Consulting is a progressive development agency specializing in eCommerce growth, backed by 17 years of industry experience. The team has closely followed the evolution of the internet and leverages this knowledge to optimize online businesses. Since 2018, Ahy Consulting has consistently delivered an average 35% increase in conversions within the first six months for eCommerce support projects. The company’s operational processes are designed to drive growth and scale, encouraging both teams and business owners to push beyond comfort zones. For more information, candidates can visit www.ahyconsulting.com.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Senior Application Security Engineer – Cryptography is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Kalyan Dombivli. This role focuses on designing, implementing, and reviewing cryptographic controls within web and application architectures supporting eCommerce platforms. The engineer will perform secure code reviews, threat modeling, and vulnerability assessments, with particular emphasis on encryption, key management, and secure data transmission. Daily responsibilities include collaborating with development teams to integrate security best practices, creating and maintaining security standards and guidelines, and responding to security incidents related to application and cryptographic components. The role also involves mentoring team members on secure development practices and contributing to continuous improvement of security tools, processes, and documentation.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Applied cryptography and security engineering skills, including experience with encryption algorithms, key management, TLS/SSL, and secure protocol design.
* Application security expertise such as secure coding practices, threat modeling, vulnerability assessment, and familiarity with OWASP guidelines.
* Hands\-on experience with web and eCommerce platforms, APIs, and cloud\-based architectures, with the ability to embed security into the development lifecycle.
* Proficiency with security tools (e.g., SAST/DAST scanners, dependency analysis, code review tools) and interpreting their results to guide remediation.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with attention to detail and a methodical approach to diagnosing and mitigating security risks.
* Effective communication skills, including the ability to explain complex security and cryptographic concepts to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; advanced security certifications (e.g., CISSP, OSCP, CEH, CSSLP) are an advantage.
* Prior experience in a senior or lead security engineering role, preferably within high\-growth, technology\-driven, or eCommerce environments.

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Ahy Consulting is a progressive development agency specializing in eCommerce growth, backed by 17 years of industry experience. The team has witnessed and adapted to the evolution of the internet, building strategies that drive measurable results for clients. Since 2018, Ahy Consulting has achieved an average 35% increase in conversions within the first six months across its eCommerce support projects. Operational processes are designed to enable sustainable growth and scale, challenging both internal teams and business owners to reach ambitious goals. More information about the company and its services is available at www.ahyconsulting.com.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Senior DevSecOps Engineer is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Kalyan Dombivli. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining secure CI/CD pipelines, integrating security controls into every stage of the software development lifecycle. The engineer will manage cloud and on\-premise infrastructure, automate deployments, monitor system performance, and ensure compliance with security best practices and standards. Daily tasks include collaborating with development and operations teams, performing vulnerability assessments, managing incident response, and improving tooling and processes for reliability, scalability, and security. The role also involves mentoring team members, documenting procedures, and contributing to architectural decisions that support eCommerce growth.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong foundation in Computer Science principles, including data structures, algorithms, and system design.
* Proficiency in Back\-End Web Development and Software Development, with experience building and maintaining APIs and microservices.
* Advanced Programming skills in one or more languages commonly used in DevSecOps environments (e.g., Python, Go, Java, or similar).
* Solid understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts and their application in secure, maintainable codebases.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) and infrastructure\-as\-code frameworks (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
* Experience implementing security practices across the SDLC, including code scanning, dependency management, and container security.
* Practical knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and Linux\-based systems administration.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams, communicate clearly, and document processes and standards.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in eCommerce or high\-traffic web applications is an advantage; relevant security certifications (e.g., CISSP, OSCP, CSSLP) are a plus.

title: Infrastructure Security Engineer - WAF,F5 & Palo Alto Firewall
description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are looking for a motivated and talented individual interested in working on
 **F5 technologies (Load Balancer, WAF, DDoS)** 
 ,
 **Palo Alto Firewalls** 
 ,
 **FortiGate Firewalls** 
 , and
 **Infoblox DNS** 
 . The role involves hands\-on security and network operations, monitoring, troubleshooting, incident response, and continuous optimization of enterprise security infrastructure.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* 
+ Work in security and network operations environments.
+ Hands\-on experience with F5 WAF, Load Balancer, and DDoS, including policies, maintenance, upgrades, certificate renewal, virtual server creation on F5 LTM, F5 LTM/ASM troubleshooting, WAF security policy management, DDoS mitigation, VIP configuration, backend and frontend IP mapping, session distribution logic, and session persistency logic.
+ Monitor web traffic, analyze security logs, investigate alerts, and take action against unusual activities.
+ Respond quickly to security breaches by collaborating with incident response teams.
+ Integrate threat intelligence feeds to enhance protection against emerging risks.
+ Continuously optimize WAF performance to minimize latency and ensure seamless user experience.
+ Conduct regular security assessments and audits to identify vulnerabilities.
+ Manage ServiceNow workflows to update and patch security services.
+ Maintain organized documentation of WAF configurations, rules, and procedures.
+ Diagnose and resolve complex network and security issues.
+ Hands\-on experience with FortiGate Firewall and FortiManager, including firewall configuration, management, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
+ Strong understanding of FortiGate firewall features such as firewall policies, IPSec VPNs, IDS/IPS, web filtering, and other security capabilities.
+ Troubleshoot IPSec VPNs, GlobalProtect VPN, high CPU utilization issues, application issues at Layer 4 and Layer 7, and NAT issues (source, destination, static, translation, hit\-related).
+ Create and manage security rules, NAT rules, security profiles, log forwarding profiles, zone security profiles, and application overrides on Palo Alto and FortiGate firewalls.
+ Perform firewall backups, firmware upgrades, device monitoring, health monitoring, and alert investigations.
+ Follow ITIL\-based change management and incident management procedures.
+ Manage inventory of all in\-scope devices.
+ Raise, track, and close TAC cases end\-to\-end.
+ Provide monthly security augmentation recommendations.
+ Create, maintain, and follow SOPs for configuration and process changes.


**Basic Qualifications \-**
* 
+ Education: BE (Computer Science / IT) or MCA or equivalent university degree.
+ Experience: 5 to 7 years of experience in the security domain.
+ Minimum 5\+ years of experience working as an L1/L2 Engineer in operations.
+ Hands\-on experience with (Palo Alto or FortiGate Firewall) and F5 Load Balancer (LB, WAF, DDoS).
+ Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols including TCP/IP, routing, and switching.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 
+ Experience with Infoblox DNS.
+ Certifications such as PCNSA, PCNSE, NSE4, or F5 Load Balancer certifications.


**Why Gruve**
 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
